title: SCA Chaos on Campus featuring Shai Davidai

chapters.title: Introduction and personal background
chapters.about: Shai Davidai's introduction and his commitment to speaking out against antisemitism.

chapters.title: The impact of social media and activism
chapters.about: The viral nature of his videos and the importance of using social media for good.

chapters.title: The reality of campus antisemitism
chapters.about: The shock of October 7th and the subsequent rise of anti-Israel sentiment at Columbia.

chapters.title: Moving forward and institutional change
chapters.about: The need for systemic changes at universities and the role of Jewish organizations.

chapters.title: Engaging with non-Jewish communities
chapters.about: Strategies for building alliances and shifting the narrative on campus.

chapters.title: Equipping the next generation
chapters.about: The story of King David and Goliath as a lesson for Jewish resilience and preparation.

chapters.title: Advice for parents and students
chapters.about: Perspectives on choosing universities and preparing children for future challenges.

summary: Shai Davidai discusses his experiences as a professor at Columbia University following October 7th and the rise of antisemitism on campus. He emphasizes the importance of Jewish students and faculty standing up for their rights rather than hiding their identity, and he offers advice on how to prepare the next generation to engage in these difficult conversations.
questions: How should Jewish students respond to antisemitism on campus?
Should parents continue to send their children to universities where antisemitism is prevalent?
How can we effectively engage with non-Jewish communities regarding the fight against antisemitism?
How can parents better prepare their children for the challenges they may face in college?
